attributes.powers: Display this card. While displayed, add 1d6 to your Constitution checks. While displayed, you may recharge a card to evade a barrier you encounter; if it has the Obstacle or Trap trait, you may put it on the bottom of its deck.
attributes.recharge: At the end of your turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may attempt a Divine 8 check to recharge it instead.
